checks: Kenobi: cold, 10 warm and 10 uncached real-engine adapter states are exactly equal. The bounded whole-state cache avoids repeated party reconstruction and damage calls; elapsed timings are recorded, not treated as a universal speed guarantee.
Every sampled HP/stat/item/ability/power/field/PP/faint/reserve input agrees with a fresh uncached engine read.
A same-event-loop input/change burst requests two refreshes and executes one; explicit synchronous refresh calls remain synchronous.
Singles and four-battler frozen references survive player changes, preserve ally matchups and use the common clone/lifecycle. Opponent slot changes and a partner at zero HP remain live.

Frozen Singles and Doubles references rebuild Water Spout/Eruption/Flail/Reversal and Focus Sash across reserve HP 100% → 50% → 100%, against the original player and field after the displayed Pokémon, weather and Magic Room change. Original trainer data is restored.
